_README: Hand-translated UI chrome for the Blueprint Finder.
Scope: ONLY the tool's own interface copy. Item names, mission titles,
factions and ranks are DATA -- they come from blueprint_explorer_data.json
and are translated by the build using CIG's official glossary, never here.
Source of this list: harvested from the LIVE rendered DOM of the running
tool (1,117 text nodes + 61 attributes), not from a regex over the source.
Regex over the inline JS was tried and proven unsafe -- it produced
fragments like "|| q === " that would corrupt the tool if translated.
STATUS: German reviewed most carefully as the test case. FR/JA/ZH are
authored but UNVERIFIED against native SC community usage -- have a native
speaker check them before treating them as final.
'patterns' handle strings composed with numbers at runtime (rep tooltips).
$1/$2/... are capture groups from the regex. Numbers are never translated.

patterns._comment: Rep requirement tooltips, composed at runtime with numbers. 61 distinct combinations were present in one render; a pattern covers all of them plus future ones. $1 rank / $2 rep amount / $3 rep per run.
patterns.de: Erfordert $1 ($2 Ruf). Bringt $3 Ruf pro Durchlauf
patterns.ja: 必要：$1（評判 $2）。1 回あたり評判 $3 獲得
patterns.zh: 需要 $1（$2 声望）。每次运行获得 $3 声望

patterns.ja: 必要：$1。1 回あたり評判 $2 獲得

patterns._comment: Per-piece 'X Obtained From:' headings, e.g. 'Antium Helmet Jet Obtained From:'. $1 is a data name, left for the data dictionary to handle.

patterns.regex: ^Database Loaded! (\d+) weapons, (\d+) ammo, (\d+) armor sets, (\d+) flight suits, (\d+) ship weapons, (\d+) components\.$
patterns.de: Datenbank geladen! $1 Waffen, $2 Munitionstypen, $3 Rüstungssets, $4 Fluganzüge, $5 Schiffswaffen, $6 Komponenten.
patterns.fr: Base de données chargée ! $1 armes, $2 munitions, $3 sets d'armure, $4 combinaisons de vol, $5 armes de vaisseau, $6 composants.
